CustomField.description: Ready-to-use guest link to this contact's Communication Preference Center, keyed by Preference_Token_Key__c (an HMAC of their email). Stamped by Trigger_Contact/Util_CommunicationPreferenceToken.buildPreferenceCenterUrl whenever Email changes. Merge directly into email templates, e.g. {!Contact.Preference_Center_Url__c} or {!Case.Contact.Preference_Center_Url__c}.
CustomField.label: Preference Center Url
